description: This file defines structures and functions for stream handling in Adobe's font processing code, specifically for reading font data streams.

classes.name: CF2_BufferRec
classes.description: Structure representing a buffer for font stream data, including error status and byte pointers.

methods.name: cf2_buf_readByte
methods.description: Reads a byte from the buffer.

methods.name: cf2_buf_isEnd
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has reached the end.
